name: qkd_seq_core_st_p

pin_regs.reason: Every functional input (programme request/position/Q valid/beat, KVN valid/tag, layer programme, hub, host, fan returns) lands in its own pin flop inside the leaf; every output is a register. A recipe-3 pin register would add an edge to the CMD->store/pop timeline that the compiled KP0/KVN_A0 offsets would have to absorb with no physical benefit.

job.purpose: KVE-2/SEQ 10-17, coordinator 0cx (3)/0db: the attention programme is the sole owner of attention RX. Successor of qkd_seq_core_static: CMD / Q events come from qkd_native_attention_programme request_valid/request_position and q_valid/q_beat (existing ports), Q data through qkd_seq_xd_sel. Bench vs qkd_seq_static on 36 link-slotted layers with the ACTUAL programme RTL: aq 1188 / kvn 72 / kc 72 per quadrant bit-identical, aq and kvn at the SAME edges, kc +1 edge (priced); mutants Q-beat swap / start late / xd_sel select FAIL.

benches.name: seq_prg_pass
benches.pass_regex: ^SEQ_PRG PASS layers=36 aq=1188 kvn=72 kc=72 errors=0 mut=0 aq_vs_ref=0..0 kvn_vs_ref=0..0 kc_vs_ref=1..1

structural_change: Successor leaf (decision 0cx (3)): att_rx_v/kind/beat and cmd_d (CMD record on the KVN wires) replaced by the attention programme's request_valid/request_position and q_valid/q_beat; a = 0 two edges after the programme request, Q pushes act&&a<32, KP0 36 (was 37) keeps pops/aq start/rows/hs on the same absolute edges; descriptor +1 edge. Pin count 1 more than r2 (no new state).
